svg.aria-label: Four-wire coin cell holder construction: in the side view, the two insulating jaws (PEEK or PTFE) of a spring clamp hold a CR2032 with the negative cap facing up. Each jaw has two gold-plated contacts on its inner face, one for the current lead and one for the sense lead, pressing on the center of the flat face. In the top view of the contact face, the two half-disc contacts are insulated from each other and must not touch the crimped rim at the cell edge. Wiring: upper jaw current contact to red CE, sense contact to white RE and orange CS; lower jaw current contact to green WE, sense contact to blue WS; black lead to the shield.
